title: Nvidia leadership turmoil weighs on AI and chip stocks
summary: Investors sold semiconductor and AI-infrastructure shares after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling sharply. The selloff highlighted concerns about leadership uncertainty and the durability of the AI investment cycle.
popularity_basis: Broad financial and technology coverage, large market moves across chip and AI-infrastructure stocks, and high potential impact on the AI sector.

title: Microsoft says global Outlook outage is stabilizing
summary: Microsoft said it had addressed the underlying network-capacity issue behind a prolonged global disruption to Outlook, Teams and Copilot, while continuing to restore remaining affected customers and regions. The company said it found no evidence of malicious activity.
popularity_basis: Extensive global coverage because the outage affected businesses, governments, airlines and financial institutions; the recovery update was widely reported.

title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for agent purchases
summary: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, allowing eligible US ChatGPT Pro users to let AI agents make purchases without directly accessing card details. Every transaction requires a security check, marking a step toward consumer-facing agentic commerce.
popularity_basis: Coverage by Reuters and prominent technology outlets; significant implications for AI agents, payments and consumer trust.

title: Cerebras shares surge after profit and forecast raise
summary: Cerebras Systems shares rose about 17 percent after the AI-chip company reported a surprise profit and raised its annual sales forecast. The results eased concerns about AI infrastructure spending and strengthened its position as a Nvidia challenger.
popularity_basis: Strong market reaction, Reuters coverage, and relevance to investor concerns over AI-chip demand and spending.

title: US Weather Service says radar systems are operating normally
summary: The US National Weather Service said its radars and radar website were operating normally after reports of nationwide internet and communications problems. It said outdated content on isolated webpages had circulated but there was no radar outage.
popularity_basis: Timely clarification from an official agency amid public concern about a potential nationwide weather-radar disruption.
